findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "update_page" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "{key}" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: publish_page, list_pages, request_decision · Public sink: publish_page, request_decision · Destructive: delete_page, request_decision.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: publish_page, list_pages, request_decision · Public sink: publish_page, request_decision · Destructive: delete_page, request_decision

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
